title: Proofs of Prophethood 21: Ridda Wars
normalized_text: welcome to another video on the proof of prophethood series i'm just going to jump in straight to the verse because this one is a prophecy from the quran oh you who believed whoever of you should revert from his religion allah will bring forth in place of them a people who will love and who will love him who are humble toward the believers strong against the disbelievers they strive in the cause of allah and do not fear the blame of a critic firstly notice that the verse says whoever of you should revert from his religion it says here minkum from among you it doesn't say whoever reverts from his religion in general it's specifically referring to the people around the prophet peace be upon him now this is a prophecy that occurred when the prophet peace be upon him passed away the arabs a lot of the tribes in the arabian peninsula apostated from islam now the first part of the prophecy is that there will be people that were muslims at the time that will leave islam that's an actual prophecy that came to pass when the prophet peace be upon him passed away and the second part of the prophecy is that allah will bring muslims to fight those that had left islam and that occurred when abu bakr fought the apostates during the riddha wars now there are a number of ways in which this prophecy could have failed one is that perhaps no one would have left islam they would have just stayed as muslims after the prophet passed away it was also possible that when the apostasy actually occurred no one would have stepped up against them in a relatively short time abu bakr successfully subjugated the apostates and the peninsula came under the rule of islam once again and that together is a clear proof of prophethood i'll see you guys in the next one assalamualaikum it's a
